pulse_note: ## 🏦 INDMoney — Weekly App Review Pulse **Week of:** 2026-03-23 | **Reviews analysed:** 215 --- ### 🔍 Top Themes This Week **1. Difficulty navigating portfolio view** — Users have reported issues with the portfolio view, such as the sizing of elements and the inability to customize the layout. > _"Every day at 9:15 AM when I place an order, it shows 'Execute the order after market open' even though the market is already open and LTP is changing. This major glitch has been happening for over a month. Also, in Scalper Mode there is no option to view index and option charts together. Very frustrating experience."_ **2. Lack of advanced charting and trading features** — Customers have requested more advanced charting capabilities, including the ability to view index and option charts together, as well as features like trailing stop-loss, partial exit, and quick exit options. > _"1) trading on chart is not available for any F&O Stocks in Flash trading app. also add trailing stop loss feature,partial exit,Quick exit feature on chart. 2) Please add index / stock chart & Option chart in same window (up & down) so we can check both chart in one page & trade easily.."_ **3. Inconsistent and high brokerage charges** — Some users have complained about the brokerage charges being higher than advertised, with charges of ₹20 per order instead of the promised ₹5 per order for F&O trading. > _"Brokerage is 20 not a 5 rs"_ **4. Technical issues and app stability**

action_ideas: Conduct a comprehensive user experience (UX) audit of the portfolio view, including usability testing and heuristic evaluation, to identify and address the navigation and layout issues reported by users. Implement a responsive and customizable portfolio view that allows users to adjust the sizing and arrangement of elements based on their preferences.

Develop a roadmap to integrate advanced charting and trading features, such as the ability to view index and option charts together, as well as implement trailing stop-loss, partial exit, and quick exit options. Engage with the user community to prioritize the most valuable features and ensure they are delivered in a timely and user-friendly manner.

Investigate the inconsistencies in brokerage charges and address the discrepancies between the advertised and actual charges. Implement a transparent and fair pricing structure, and communicate any changes or updates to the user community. Additionally, focus on improving the overall technical stability and reliability of the app to reduce crashes, order execution issues, and data lags, which have led to negative user experiences and financial losses.
